period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited) As on 30 September 2013' and 'Profit & Loss Account (Un-audited) for the period ended 30 September 2013' blocks (distinct from the 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' and 'Consolidated Profit & Loss Account' blocks on the same infographic page). Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Sep 2013' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended Jul to Sep 2013' column (interest income 4,429,446,039; PAT 503,420,898; EPS 1.14) not recorded as line items here. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo). Consolidated cross-reference (same date, cumulative, for comparison only, NOT used as primary): Total Assets 180,849 BDT_million, Total Liabilities 167,391, Total shareholders' equity (BRAC Bank Ltd) 12,582, Minority interest 876, Total equity 13,458, consolidated PAT-cumulative 1,336 (attributable to BRAC Bank Ltd equity holders 826; minority -29), consolidated EPS-cumulative 3.08. Balance sheet identity (solo) reconciles to within BDT 1 million: 157,476 (Total Liabilities) + 11,576 (Total Equity) = 169,052 vs reported Total Property and Assets 169,051 (rounding). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly. Paid-up share capital rose from BDT 3,855mn (March 2013) to BDT 4,433mn here — a ~15% bonus share issue mid-2013 (ratio exactly 1.15), consistent with the EPS-restatement ratio also observed in the 2014 Q1 filing's comparative column.
